name: Sakurajosui
tagline: Shinjuku in 14 minutes and Shibuya in 22 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, served by Keio Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 14 minutes to Shinjuku, 22 minutes to Shibuya and 45 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 45.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 45.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 40.4 m to 46.8 m, a difference of 6.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: サミット 上北沢店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 12 clinics and 12 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 回心会 ロイヤル病院, about 7 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 吉川内科小児科病院, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keio Line.
congestion: Keio Line runs at 145% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 下高井戸→明大前, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Kami-Kitazawa is ahead on quiet, but Sakurajosui is ahead on the number of medical facilities.

noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
荒玉水道道路 (1 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Keio Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
